verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
For You have been my refuge for all of my life
So let me dwell in your house forever
And I'll find my refuge in the shelter of Your wings

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Hear my cry, O Lord, and listen to my prayer
You have been my strength against my enemies
For You have heard my vows
And given me a portion with the ones who fear Your name

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
My soul waits
For You alone
In You is
My salvation

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
And from the ends of the earth I call out to You
And when my heart is failing I'll call out to You
